review_method: Candidate-bound technical licence/source review, not a legal opinion. The maintainer requested autonomous completion of the public release. Publication remains gated until source and notice delivery are complete.

requirements: Retain original copyright, permission and warranty notices and referenced complete licence texts.
For GPL3/LGPL3 elections include the applicable full texts and clear component-specific distribution/election notices.
An existing copyright file containing an instruction to give an attribution is not automatically proof that the required affirmative attribution has been supplied.
Do not call the entire image Apache-2.0, fully open-source, or patent-cleared.
BSD/MIT/ISC variants retain their exact notice/disclaimer and non-endorsement conditions.
Apache-2.0 components require applicable licence and NOTICE handling and preservation of attribution and modification notices.
FreeType FTL requires an acknowledgement/disclaimer in distribution documentation.
IJG-derived libjpeg requires the accompanying-documentation acknowledgement specified in its licence.
Bitstream Vera font terms include naming/modification and sale-related conditions; preserve the actual licence.
libmysofa MIT-KEMAR data requires author citation when used in research or commercial applications.
Retain applicable AOM, VPX, rav1e and other patent-licence notices; these do not establish clearance for all third-party patents.
Provide no-further-charge equivalent access to complete Corresponding Source.
Third-party servers are expressly allowed.
Maintain clear directions next to the object code describing exactly where matching Corresponding Source can be obtained.
The distributor remains responsible for source availability for as long as needed to satisfy the licence.
Do not require a formal upstream hosting agreement that the licence does not require.
Do not conflate section 6(d) with a three-year written offer.
Verify availability and completeness, monitor links and have a practical replacement or mirror response if a host stops providing required source.
Section 13 permits a later LGPL version when the library's grant explicitly allows later versions; it does not turn every copy of the LGPL2.1 text into an or-later grant.
LGPL3 combined works need prominent library-use notices and both GPL3 and LGPL3 texts.
Do not restrict modification of library portions or reverse engineering for debugging modifications.
Satisfy LGPL3 section 4(d): appropriate Minimal Corresponding Source and Corresponding Application Code, or a suitable replaceable shared-library mechanism.
Provide Installation Information where applicable.
Keep the source and relinking/replacement materials matched to the actual binary and dependency versions.

section3_warning.explanation: Section 3 is a distinct conversion to ordinary GPL: it requires altering all notices referring to the LGPL to refer to the selected GPL version, with no other notice change, and is irreversible for that copy. This review does not claim that merely adding a GPL3 link performs that conversion and does not recommend using it to rewrite the immutable release.

requirements: Preserve the applicable v2/v2.1 distribution conditions.
Provide complete corresponding source and required build/install materials through an accompanying or defensible same-place/equivalent-access arrangement.
For LGPL works also satisfy notice and replacement/relinking conditions; source hosting does not replace those conditions.
A third-party upstream link is not assumed to satisfy the older licences' same-place wording.
No written offer is elected by this review.
Make covered source including modifications available under MPL2.
Inform binary recipients how to obtain that source by reasonable means in a timely manner and at no more than distribution cost.
Preserve source licence notices and recipients' rights.
Check applicable secondary-licence conditions for a larger GPL combination rather than assuming all MPL versions are GPL-compatible.
Provide information on obtaining complete DB source and accompanying software using DB.
Source must be included or available for no more than distribution cost plus a nominal fee and freely redistributable under reasonable conditions.
For executables cover all contained modules, subject to the stated operating-system component exclusion.
Account for jackd2, not just db5.3.
Exact Debian versions require Debian source, patches and build materials, not merely an upstream release of a similar version.
Include statically incorporated source and required build dependencies; installed dpkg source mappings alone are incomplete.
Preserve all required notices when mirroring complete source archives.
Validate binary/source correspondence and licence compatibility separately.
Mirror-only classification is not a declaration that mirroring cures other licence defects.
